subject: Capacity MAP & evaluation schedule — Dedicated pool reservation for Cascadia Health
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
To: Natalie Ortiz <natalie@cascadia.ai>; Cassandra Wu <cassandra@cascadia.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity MAP & evaluation schedule — Dedicated pool reservation for Cascadia Health

Hi Natalie / Cassandra —

Thanks again for the time today. To make sure the MAP (mutual action plan) lines up with your procurement and security windows, I put together a concise ask-list and two reservation options for Dedicated capacity. Key constraints for us are 8–10 week lead time for procurement + GPU provisioning in us-west, and an additional 2–3 weeks for canary/validation on your eval prompts.

Quick summary (high level):
- Option A: Reserve 8x A100-equivalent slots (preferred) — delivery target: 10/18 if PO by 9/23.
- Option B: Reserve 4x A100-equivalent slots (min viable) — delivery target: 10/04 if PO by 9/23; can scale to 8x in mid-Nov with follow-up commit.

Action items for Cascadia:
1) Confirm preferred option (A or B) and region (us-west vs us-east).
2) Sign the SOW/PO or indicate procurement path and estimated approval date.
3) Share the evaluation prompt-set (we'll use for canary runs) and any SLO latency targets.

Attached: MAP_Capacity_Snapshot_v2.xlsx (rough timeline + gating), Cascadia-eval-plan.pdf (format we used in previous evals).

I'll loop Neha on provisioning details and Karthik on performance tuning. If we get PO/commit by 9/23 EOD PT, the team can meet the Option A timeline; otherwise we'll recommend Option B to avoid blocking your initial rollout.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Natalie Ortiz <natalie@cascadia.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
Cc: Cassandra Wu <cassandra@cascadia.ai>, procure@cascadia.ai
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity MAP & evaluation schedule — Dedicated pool reservation for Cascadia Health

Marcus —

Appreciate the summary. We're aligned on the high level. Quick points from my side:
- We'd like to target Option A but need Procurement to sign off on the capex/commit.
- Procurement lead says they can turn around PO in 10 business days once the SOW + pricing are final (so earliest 9/23 + 10 BD -> ~10/07). That pushes us past your Option A cutoff.
- Is there a way to do a soft hold on capacity (non-billable, refundable) while procurement completes? If not, Option B + rapid scale is the fallback.

I'll attach the evaluation prompt set and a quick doc on our compliance gating (HIPAA scope) separately. I can escalate procurement if we need faster turnaround.

—Natalie
Head of ML Ops, Cascadia Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity MAP & evaluation schedule — Dedicated pool reservation for Cascadia Health

Folks —

I reviewed Marcus's timeline and did a quick probe with infra: we can offer a 7-calendar-day soft hold (non-billable) if Cascadia signs a short commitment form and agrees to a guaranteed start date within 30 days. Soft hold would reserve the exact GPU SKU and region but not spin up instances until the start date.

Implications:
- Soft hold requires an internal capacity earmark and an ops runway (we'll need a final SOW + contact person)
- If start date slips >30d, hold converts to a 30%-prorated reservation fee (to compensate for lost planning)

If Procurement can promise the PO by 10/07, the soft hold gets them to Option A delivery (we estimate provisioning 10/15–10/18 after PO). Without a hold, Option B is safe and can be scaled with an expedited 3–4 week add-on.

I attached an internal checklist to scope the canary (security scans, k8s network ACLs, KMS onboarding).

Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Cassandra Wu <cassandra@cascadia.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>
Cc: Natalie Ortiz <natalie@cascadia.ai>, procure@cascadia.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity MAP & evaluation schedule — Dedicated pool reservation for Cascadia Health

Marcus / Neha —

Thanks — procurement has two options: rapid-approve (requires exec approval) or standard PO (10 BD). Exec is willing to fast-track if Redwood can provide: 1) a one-page commitment letter we can show to CFO, and 2) a clear rollback/cost cap for the pilot so they can limit spend exposure.

Can you produce a one-page commitment and a brief cost cap addendum by Friday (9/24)? If yes, we can escalate and aim for the 9/27 exec review.

Cassandra
Director, Procurement, Cascadia Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>
To: Cassandra Wu <cassandra@cascadia.ai>, Natalie Ortiz <natalie@cascadia.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity MAP & evaluation schedule — Dedicated pool reservation for Cascadia Health

Cassandra / Natalie —

We can do that. Action plan from Redwood side:
- Priyom will draft a one-page commitment letter (non-binding until SOW) and a one-page pilot cost cap (max spend for 30-day pilot).
- Neha will prepare the soft-hold agreement language and attach the provisioning timeline (we'll include the 7-day soft hold + conversion terms).
- Karthik will outline the canary validation checklist (latency targets, sample prompt-run plan, and rollback criteria).

Deliverables and ETA: all three docs to you by 9/24 EOD PT. If procurement can get exec review on 9/27 and outcome is positive, we can execute soft hold immediately and aim for Option A provisioning window (10/15–10/18). If procurement stays standard timeline, Option B will be reserved and we will plan a scale-up in mid-Nov.

Next steps for Cascadia: please confirm which exec will review the one-pager and a preferred contact for DocuSign. Also send the prompt-set and compliance doc when ready.

Thanks — we’ll follow up with the attachments and HubSpot links.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs: MAP_Capacity_Snapshot_v2.xlsx, Cascadia-eval-plan.pdf, SOW-draft-RWI-8421.docx]
